openings.claim: A pattern-specific placement ledger pencilled on each envelope may prevent missing items and mistaken pattern assignment by making completion depend on counted placement rather than remembered picking.
openings.delta: Retain tagged trays and samples, but copy each assigned pattern's quantities and dimensions onto its envelope; mark a line only after placing that material, compare the filled contents with the ledger before closing, and leave the pattern identifier visible for distribution. Move checking into assembly.
openings.prediction: With shared trays retained and pattern mixture matched, ledger envelopes will show fewer audited omissions than incumbent envelopes. Any missing item will usually leave an unmarked line; exterior identifiers will permit correct assignment without opening envelopes.
openings.rival_prediction: The nearest alternative is local material staging: shared picking and crossing cause omissions. Under that account, loose materials beside each volunteer will improve completeness while a ledger with shared trays will add time without reliably preventing omissions.
openings.defeat: An omitted item beside a completed ledger line defeats the claimed placement safeguard for that event; unchanged omission rates alongside improvement from local staging defeat its proposed main causal advantage. Exceeding 90 minutes defeats full-task fit.
openings.probe: Within a two-volunteer, 90-minute session, alternate matched pattern blocks across incumbent assembly, shared-tray ledger assembly, and local staging without a ledger. Count setup, copying, checking and correction time; audit all contents before distribution and record ledger discrepancies. Keep every block inside the existing table and use only existing supplies. A subsequent complete 60-kit ledger run must finish within 90 minutes with at most one distribution correction before claiming success.
assumptions: Samples accurately expose every specified quantity and dimension.
Enough usable specified materials exist for all 60 kits; O5 establishes only one reserve packet.
Copying and checking can fit the time budget; this is unverified.
Existing supplies permit the comparison layouts within the table; opened-packet area is unknown.
The supplied records are synthetic stipulations; this evaluates a proposed probe and unproven intervention.
